invariants: Inferred edges are labeled and reviewable.
Stronger tests, contracts, behavior, evidence, and aliases survive reconciliation.
procedure: Normalize capability identity, aliases, versions, and owners.
Extract dependencies, semantic effects, tests, and runtime paths.
Infer typed relations with evidence and confidence.
Detect cycles, orphans, fragile hubs, duplication, and gaps.
Require review and recertification for destructive or superseding changes.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Infer extends, composes, conflicts-with, duplicates, aliases, replaces, supersedes, and co-executes relations from contracts, tests, behavior, and traces.
title: Capability Relation Inferencer
when_to_use: Use after corpus imports, generated skill waves, refactors, and merges.
